title: Set up the interview question bank behind 14 hiring events
summary: I proposed changes to how the fraud and risk org interviewed engineers, ran a question-writing session across two offices, and built a shared bank of test-case-backed questions used in 14 weekend hiring events.
what_would_have_happened: Interviewers kept improvising questions, so the bar varied from panel to panel.
the_call: Give every panel the same tested questions and answers, so hiring decisions compare like with like.
what_i_did: Organized the question bash with a colleague at the second site, wrote 10 of the first 20 questions, kept the bank in one template and shared it with leaders travelling to interview.
what_changed: 30-plus questions were used in 14 weekend hiring events and 2 online drives.
